QuestInfo.name: Letter Delivery
QuestInfo.1:
Dad is very surprised, and wants you to something else for him as well. He asks that you deliver a letter to #r#p1012003##k in #b#m100000000##k, explaining the shortage of #t4032453# due to the #o1210111#s. Take the letter Dad has given you and go to town.

Farm Entrance-> The Hill North of Henesys -> Henesys

1.0: Hmm... Aren't you Evan, #p1013103#'s son? What are you doing here? Huh? #p1013103# asked you to deliver this letter? Let's see...

npc.0: You haven't gone to #b#m100000000##k yet? If it's because you're afraid of the #o1210111#s, just tell me.

item.0: Hmm... Aren't you Evan, #p1013103#'s son? What are you doing here? I heard #p1013101# is busy helping out at the farm. But are you just running around having fun? Tsk tsk.

quest.0: Have you lost the letter? I really wonder who's side of the family your clumsiness comes from. I'll just write another letter... Here. Take this and go to #b#m100000000##k.
